subject: Cloud QC: make cse (Cloud Security Engineer) path shippable + expose
description: Scout verdict 2026-07-23: the 'cse' EC-Council Cloud Security Engineer LearningPath is content-SHIPPABLE but NOT exposed on cloud/index.html paths list.
